request.input:
1boy, solo, full body, seated behind a compact drum kit, relaxed shoulders rolled forward, slightly hunched upper back, torso leaning forward. Elbows near knees, each hand loosely holding one drumstick across lap, sticks crossing below hands. Head turned toward screen-left, calm tired expression.

Quiet rehearsal studio after a loud performance, amplifiers on both sides, acoustic wall panels, guitar leaning at image-right, microphones and floor cables.

Wide horizontal view, drummer centered, shoes visible, knees apart. Low frontal camera, bass drum below lap, toms beside torso, large cymbals above both sides. Foreground hardware frames him without obscuring face or hands.

Warm overhead spotlight, pale rounded light pool on rear wall, coherent bare-head shadow. Warm face and hands, narrow golden cymbal reflections, muted olive, gunmetal and ivory palette, surrounding room in shadow.
